title: Typed deciders audit: frozen answers, code and proofs for "Confidence Is Not a Promise" (v1.0)
description: Reference package for auditing typed decision models. It holds the frozen answers of Laya (open weights, as released and fine-tuned, every option's probability) and Jev 1.13 (closed, through the vendor API, the decided option with its probability and whether it is right) on five-option intent questions from MASSIVE 1.1 in 52 locales, under typing noise, on coalition games of the words of each utterance and on four further domains, with a datasheet and a manifest of SHA-256 sums. It also holds the code that produces every number of the article Confidence Is Not a Promise: A Reference Audit of Typed Decision Models, the preregistration and implementation notes, a standalone check of a selective-accuracy promise across populations with its test, and Lean 4 proofs of the selective ceiling and of the dynamic gate.
